headline: Quiet weekend: mainland press (Beijing Business Today, 9 Aug) puts numbers on the China 20% offshore-insurance tax plus a stronger RMB — a 6% HK policy nets ~5.2%, volumes seen down ~10%
blurb: A continuation day led again by the China/Hong Kong offshore-insurance thread. The one genuinely new in-window item is a Beijing Business Today (北京商报, 9 Aug) assessment shifting the story from market panic to client economics: on its illustration a 20-year policy projected at 6% nets ~5.2% after the 20% IIT on the return leg, while the RMB's ~4.2% rise vs USD in 2025 separately erodes converted proceeds. Context: mainland visitors wrote ~HK$62.8bn of new HK premiums in 2024 (~30% of the market); analysts see ~10% volume drag, cushioned by HK products still illustrating 6–7% vs ~3% onshore. Officials (HK IA + STA) maintain the IIT obligation 'has always existed'. Offshore-trust 20% IIT runs on (90-day window to ~21 Oct). UK/US/SG/secondary quiet; Taiwan succession reforms continue. UK leadership (PM Burnham, Chancellor Healey) re-verified unchanged; Budget 28 Oct.
headline_zh: 週末平靜：大陸媒體（北京商報，8月9日）為中國20%境外保險稅疊加人民幣走強給出數字——6%的香港保單淨報酬約5.2%，保單量估降約10%
blurb_zh: 延續性日報，再以中國／香港境外保險主線為首。期間內唯一真正新進項目為北京商報（8月9日）之評析，將議題自市場恐慌轉向客戶實質經濟效益：以其示例，一份預期6%之20年期保單於收益段課徵20%個稅後淨報酬約5.2%，而2025年人民幣兌美元升值約4.2%另侵蝕換回本幣之給付。脈絡：2024年內地訪客貢獻香港新保費約628億港元（約佔市場30%）；分析預估保單量或降約10%，惟香港產品仍以6–7%示例、相較境內約3%而具緩衝。官方（香港保監局與國家稅務總局）維持個稅義務「一直存在」之立場。離岸信託20%個稅持續（90天披露期至約10月21日）。英／美／星及次要法域平靜；台灣繼承改革延續。英國領導層（首相Burnham、財相Healey）核實不變；預算10月28日。

headline: Beijing's tax authority steps in: China's State Taxation Administration says the 20% levy on offshore/HK insurance returns is 'not a new policy' and 'not aimed at Hong Kong', urging no over-interpretation (7 Aug)
blurb: Top cross-border move: the central State Taxation Administration (STA), not just the HK regulator, has now weighed in on the Hong Kong/offshore-insurance tax row. On 7 Aug, via Xinhua, the STA said taxing mainland residents' overseas insurance returns is not newly introduced and not targeted at Hong Kong — China's IIT law has always taxed residents on worldwide income; investment returns are treated the same across assets (insurance, securities, funds) and jurisdictions; enforcement is only catching up as CRS matures. SCMP, The Standard and Dim Sum Daily carry the clarification; a Securities Times explainer (6 Aug) sets out that the 20% bites on the return leg (participating dividends, ILAS/account gains, surrenders, interest on prepaid premiums) while death/critical-illness/medical payouts stay exempt. The parallel offshore-trust 20% IIT runs on (90-day window to ~21 Oct). UK/US/SG/secondary quiet in-window; Taiwan's twin succession reforms continue. UK leadership (PM Burnham, Chancellor Healey) re-verified unchanged.
headline_zh: 北京稅務主管機關出面：中國國家稅務總局稱對境外／香港保單收益課20%稅「並非新政策」、「更非針對香港」，籲勿過度解讀（8月7日）
blurb_zh: 跨境焦點：出面回應香港／境外保險課稅風波者，已由香港監管機構升至中央國家稅務總局。8月7日，稅務總局經新華社表示，對內地居民境外保險收益課稅並非新增、亦非針對香港——中國個稅法一向就居民全球所得課稅；投資收益不論資產類別（保險、證券、基金）與法域，處理一致；如今得以執行僅因CRS趨於成熟。南華早報、英文虎報及Dim Sum Daily均轉述此澄清；證券時報解說（8月6日）指20%課於收益段（分紅派發、投連／帳戶收益、退保、預繳保費利息），身故／重疾／醫療給付則免稅。並行之離岸信託20%個稅持續（90天披露期至約10月21日）。英／美／星及次要法域期間內平靜；台灣兩項繼承改革延續。英國領導層（首相Burnham、財相Healey）核實不變。

headline: Regulators respond to China's 20% tax on Hong Kong insurance returns: HK Insurance Authority and FS Paul Chan say the obligation 'has always existed', urge no over-interpretation, as insurers fall for a second session (7 Aug)
blurb: A continuation day led by the HK/offshore insurance thread. Two days after Caixin's exclusive on Beijing/Hangzhou levying 20% IIT on mainland residents' HK policy returns (dividends/participating payouts and interest on prepaid premiums), Hong Kong's Insurance Authority and Financial Secretary Paul Chan stepped in to steady the market: this is enforcement of a pre-existing IIT obligation, applied case-by-case, not a new tax or blanket back-tax. Insurer shares still fell again on 7 Aug (AIA -5.9%, Prudential -4.6%, Manulife -2.1%; Hang Seng -1.5% to 25,530); Bloomberg Intelligence flags ~2% NBV drag per 10% fall in mainland-visitor new sales. The offshore-trust IIT runs on in the background (90-day window to ~21 Oct). UK/US/Singapore/secondary quiet in-window; HMRC's final non-dom stats (4 Aug, GBP13.6bn, +9%) noted as just-outside-window context. UK leadership (PM Burnham, Chancellor Healey) re-verified unchanged.
headline_zh: 監管機構回應中國對香港保單收益課20%稅：香港保監局及財政司司長陳茂波稱義務「一直存在」、籲勿過度解讀，保險股連跌第二日（8月7日）
blurb_zh: 延續性日報，以香港／境外保險主線為首。財新獨家報導北京、杭州就內地居民香港保單收益（分紅派發及預繳保費利息）課徵20%個稅兩日後，香港保險業監管局及財政司司長陳茂波出面穩定市場：此為對既有個稅義務之個案執法，並非新稅或全面追繳。惟8月7日保險股再跌（友邦−5.9%、保誠−4.6%、宏利−2.1%；恒指−1.5%至25,530點）；彭博行業研究指內地訪客新單每跌10%，新業務價值約降2%。離岸信託個稅於背景持續（90天披露期至約10月21日）。英國／美國／新加坡／次要法域期間內平靜；HMRC最終版非居籍統計（8月4日，136億英鎊、+9%）作窗口外背景。英國領導層（首相Burnham、財相Healey）核實不變。

headline: China widens its 20% net from trusts to Hong Kong insurance: Beijing/Hangzhou start taxing mainland residents' policy returns (Caixin exclusive, 5 Aug); Prudential, HSBC, AIA & StanChart slide on 6 Aug
blurb: A major new front in China's CRS-driven crackdown: tax bureaux in Beijing and Hangzhou have begun levying 20% IIT on the returns of Hong Kong/offshore insurance policies held by mainland residents — dividend distributions and interest on prepaid premiums (Caixin exclusive, 5 Aug). Markets reacted hard on 6 Aug (Prudential −12% intraday, AIA −8%, HSBC/StanChart lower), though Citi and Goldman both call the insurer selloff overdone: no central Beijing directive, some cited cases from 2025, insurance only ~4–5% of HSBC/StanChart, and no blanket back-tax demanded yet. A distinct thread from the offshore-trust IIT (same 20% rate/CRS enabler, different asset class); the trust regime's 90-day disclosure window runs to ~21 Oct. UK leadership (PM Burnham, Chancellor Healey) re-verified unchanged.
headline_zh: 中國20%課稅網由信託擴及香港保險：北京、杭州開始就內地居民保單收益課稅（財新獨家，8月5日）；保誠、匯豐、友邦、渣打8月6日重挫
blurb_zh: 中國以CRS為基礎的稽查開闢重大新戰線：北京、杭州稅務機關已開始就內地居民持有之香港／境外保單收益課徵20%個人所得稅——分紅派發及預繳保費之利息（財新獨家，8月5日）。市場於8月6日反應劇烈（保誠盤中−12%、友邦−8%、匯豐與渣打亦跌），惟花旗與高盛均認為保險股拋售過度：北京並無統一指令、部分案例發生於2025年、保險僅占匯豐／渣打約4–5%，且暫未要求全面補稅。此與離岸信託個稅為不同主線（稅率同為20%、同以CRS為基礎，但屬不同資產類別）；信託制度90天披露期至約10月21日。英國領導層（首相Burnham、財政大臣Healey）經再次確認不變。

headline: China offshore-trust fallout hits mainstream press: CNBC (5 Aug) reports super-rich 'in shock', racing for advice and liquidity before the ~21 Oct disclosure deadline
blurb: One genuinely new in-window article: a 5 Aug CNBC feature on the behavioural fallout from China's 20% offshore-trust IIT (Announcement 2026 No. 21) — private banks, trustees and law firms fielding urgent HNW enquiries, with liquidity the squeeze since the charge can fall on undistributed gains held in illiquid assets, and the 90-day voluntary-disclosure window (to ~21 Oct) driving the scramble. No new development elsewhere: China and Taiwan's twin succession reforms remain the two live threads. UK leadership (PM Burnham, Chancellor Healey) re-verified unchanged.
headline_zh: 中國離岸信託衝擊登上主流媒體：CNBC（8月5日）報導富豪「深感震驚」，於約10月21日披露期限前急尋建議與資金
blurb_zh: 期間內有一則真正新進的文章：8月5日CNBC專題報導中國離岸信託20%個人所得稅（《2026年第21號公告》）之行為面衝擊——私人銀行、受託人與律師事務所應接大量高淨值家族緊急諮詢；由於稅負可能落在流動性偏低資產所持之未分配收益上，資金流動性成為壓力所在，90天自願披露期（至約10月21日）驅動此波搶尋建議。其他方面無新發展：中國與台灣兩項繼承改革仍為兩條主線。英國領導層（首相Burnham、財政大臣Healey）經再次確認不變。

headline: Afternoon refresh — one new in-window item (Caixin explainer on China's offshore-trust 20% IIT); two live threads run on: China disclosure window (~11 weeks left) & Taiwan's twin succession reforms
blurb: Afternoon run added one genuinely new in-window article: a 4 Aug Caixin explainer on China's offshore-trust regime (continued coverage; notes ~RMB13bn of CRS-driven back taxes paid by June 2026). No new development otherwise — China's 20% offshore-trust IIT live with its 90-day voluntary-disclosure window to ~21 Oct; Taiwan's Estate & Gift Tax anti-disclaimer amendment sits with the Legislature and the Civil Code sibling reserved-portion repeal awaits promulgation. UK leadership (PM Burnham, Chancellor Healey) re-verified unchanged.
headline_zh: 下午更新——期間內新增一則（財新對中國離岸信託20%個稅之解說）；兩項主線持續：中國披露期（尚餘約11週）與台灣兩項繼承改革
blurb_zh: 下午排程新增一則於期間內之新文章：8月4日財新對中國離岸信託制度之解說（後續報導；指截至2026年6月已就境外所得透過CRS補繳約人民幣130億元）。其餘無新發展——中國離岸信託20%個稅已生效，90天自願披露期至約10月21日；台灣《遺產及贈與稅法》反拋棄修正案現於立法院，《民法》兄弟姊妹特留分廢除待總統公布。英國領導層（首相Burnham、財政大臣Healey）經再次確認不變。

headline: Quiet start to the week — no new in-window article; two live threads run on: China's 20% offshore-trust IIT (90-day disclosure clock to ~21 Oct) and Taiwan's twin succession reforms
blurb: An exhaustive EN/Chinese sweep found no genuinely new in-window private-client tax article overnight; every fresh piece traces to the 24-31 July cluster already carried. The edition summarises the state of play on the two live threads: China's 20% offshore-trust income tax (Announcement 2026 No. 21, effective 24 Jul) with its 90-day voluntary-disclosure window running to ~21 October, and Taiwan's parallel reforms (Estate & Gift Tax Act anti-disclaimer amendment now with the Legislature; Civil Code art. 1223 abolition of siblings' forced heirship, effective 6 months after promulgation). UK/US/HK/SG and secondary quiet; Burnham PM and Healey Chancellor re-verified.
headline_zh: 本週開局平靜——期間內無新文章；兩項主線持續：中國20%離岸信託個稅（90天披露期至約10月21日）及台灣兩項並行繼承改革
blurb_zh: 經徹底之中英文檢索，一夜之間並無真正新進、於期間內發布的私人客戶稅務文章；所有較新內容均可追溯至已收錄之7月24日至31日一輪報導。本期彙整兩項主線之現況：中國對離岸信託所得課徵20%個人所得稅（《2026年第21號公告》，7月24日生效），90天自願披露期倒數至約10月21日；台灣兩項並行改革（《遺產及贈與稅法》反拋棄修正案現於立法院；《民法》第1223條廢除兄弟姊妹特留分，總統公布後六個月施行）。英美港星及次要法域平靜；Burnham首相、Healey財政大臣經再次確認。

headline: Quiet weekend — Taiwan leads with twin succession reforms: Estate & Gift Tax anti-disclaimer amendment (continued) and Civil Code abolition of siblings' forced heirship
blurb: Priority jurisdictions (UK/US/China/HK/SG) quiet over the weekend; no fresh in-window item and China's 20% offshore-trust 90-day disclosure clock keeps ticking to ~21 Oct. Taiwan leads: Focus Taiwan (31 Jul) adds mechanics to the Estate & Gift Tax Act amendment (proportional recipient-borne tax on 2-year pre-death gifts; taxpayer-favourable spousal-deduction fix), and a Taipei Times editorial (2 Aug) covers the Legislature's abolition of siblings' forced-heirship reserved portion (Civil Code art. 1223; effective 6 months after promulgation).
headline_zh: 平靜的週末——台灣以兩項繼承改革領銜：《遺產及贈與稅法》反拋棄修正（後續）及《民法》廢除兄弟姊妹特留分
blurb_zh: 重點法域（英／美／中／港／星）週末平靜；期間內無新項目，中國20%離岸信託90天披露期持續倒數至約10月21日。台灣領銜：Focus Taiwan（7月31日）補充《遺產及贈與稅法》修正機制（死亡前兩年贈與按比例由受贈人負擔遺產稅；有利納稅人之配偶扣除額調整）；《台北時報》社論（8月2日）評立法院廢除兄弟姊妹特留分（《民法》第1223條，總統公布後六個月施行）。

headline: Afternoon refresh — Taiwan Cabinet approves Estate & Gift Tax Act amendment (anti-disclaimer 'first-wife' clause); China offshore-trust thread continues
blurb: Afternoon edition adds Taiwan: the Executive Yuan approved (30 Jul) a draft Estate & Gift Tax Act amendment closing the disclaimer-of-inheritance loophole — recipients of two-year deemed-estate gifts bear estate tax proportionally, plus a spousal 'first-wife' clause; installment cap removed. Now to the Legislative Yuan. Priority jurisdictions (UK/US/China/HK/SG) quiet; China 20% offshore-trust IIT thread continues (AllBright Q&A, 90-day window to ~21 Oct).
headline_zh: 午後更新——台灣行政院通過《遺產及贈與稅法》修正草案（防拋棄繼承「大老婆條款」）；中國離岸信託主線延續
blurb_zh: 資訊較少的一天；隔夜重點法域無新進展。期間內唯一項目為錦天城〈九大困惑〉實務問答（7月30日），評析中國離岸信託20%個稅：外國護照無法切斷中國稅務居民身分、代持不予認可、三個應稅環節不得相互抵減。90天披露期約至10月21日截止。英美港星及次要法域均平靜。

headline: Afternoon refresh: China offshore-trust coverage deepens — mainstream press (国际金融报) plus critical practitioner notes (Anli, Lantai) on Announcement No. 21
blurb: Afternoon edition adds two in-window items, both China offshore-trust continued coverage: International Finance News (30 Jul) on the 20% regime's reach and closing the deferral loophole, and Lantai Law (29 Jul) flagging change-of-residence as a taxable trigger. Alongside Anli Law's critical '10 questions' piece. UK/US/HK/SG and secondary quiet.
headline_zh: 午後更新：中國離岸信託報導深化——主流財經媒體（國際金融報）加實務批判評析（安理、兰台）並論21號公告
blurb_zh: 午後版新增兩則窗口內項目，均為中國離岸信託持續報導：國際金融報（7月30日）論20%新規之影響與封堵遞延籌劃，兰台律師（7月29日）點出身分變更即為應稅觸發事件；並與安理〈十大問題〉批判評析並列。英美港星及次要法域均平靜。

headline: China offshore-trust tax, afternoon refresh: Conyers trustee-side alert + Sina Finance founder-exposure detail (Lei Bin US$2bn cash-out, ~¥150bn deferred)
blurb: Afternoon edition. Three new in-window items on Announcement 2026 No.21: Conyers analyses trustee obligations and the death-of-settlor trigger; Sina Finance details Lei Bin's US$2bn Xiaomi cash-out running into the 20% charge and a founder-by-founder back-tax tally. UK/US/HK/SG quiet.

headline: UK 'death tax' watch: Burnham's social-care statement lands with NO tax measures — funding parked with Casey commission
blurb: Afternoon refresh. PM's 29 Jul statement announced no estate levy and ruled out income tax/VAT/NI; funding deferred to Baroness Casey's commission. Adds GOV.UK primary, City AM, ITV and Gravita firm analysis. China 20% offshore-trust covera

headline: China offshore-trust rules: Dentons firm alert + official MOF Q&A and Caixin analysis (expanded on demand)
blurb: Expanded on demand under the new inclusive criteria: adds the MOF/STA press Q&A and Caixin's analysis alongside the first firm alert (Dentons) on China's 20% offshore-trust income tax. Priority jurisdictions otherwise light in-window.

headline: UK CEOs press Burnham to cut taxes (added on-demand); China rules see continued HK-focused coverage
blurb: Automated morning edition refreshed on demand at 17:53 BST: adds one genuinely new item — UK business leaders urging PM Burnham to cut taxes (Bloomberg, 27 Jul). SCMP's Hong-Kong-focused China piece is continued coverage of the 24 Jul rules, not a new development.

headline: Quiet day — on-demand refresh (20:48 BST) confirms no new items beyond earlier editions
blurb: Manually re-scanned on demand: nothing genuinely new in the last 48h beyond what earlier editions carry. China's offshore-trust rules (24 Jul) and the UK change-of-government thread (20–22 Jul) sit in their dated editions and on new story-tracker pages.

headline: Quiet day — Neidle questions whether Scotland's 48p top rate raises anything
blurb: A light day. Tax Policy Associates (Dan Neidle) argues Scotland's 48% additional rate may sit past the peak of the Laffer curve, raising little net revenue once migration and income-shifting are counted. Priority jurisdictions otherwise quiet.

headline: China brings offshore trusts into income tax (20%); US QDOT technical fix; Australia estate-relevant drafts
blurb: China's MOF/STA clarify a 20% individual income tax on residents' offshore-trust income with a 90-day disclosure window — the week's biggest private-client move. Plus UK firm commentary (RPC) on the Elborne IHT win and new Loan Charge settlement regulations, a US QDOT regulation correction, and Australian estate/family-law drafts.

headline: Quiet day — Canada opens consultation on draft tax legislation
blurb: A light day. Canada's Finance Department opened consultation on draft legislative proposals (FAPI, Disability Tax Credit and technical measures); limited direct private-client content. Priority jurisdictions otherwise quiet.

headline: Burnham walks back personal-allowance unfreeze; ~£22bn gap points to autumn tax rises
blurb: UK: Burnham rows back on lifting the frozen £12,570 personal allowance; ~£22bn of unfunded pledges fuels 'guaranteed' autumn tax-rise talk. Industry warns MAS that managers eye a Hong Kong move.

headline: Burnham scraps electricity VAT for six months; HMRC IHT receipts hit record £2.3bn
blurb: UK: Burnham removes VAT on domestic electricity for six months from October; HMRC inheritance-tax receipts reach a record £2.3bn for the quarter as frozen bands bite.

headline: UK change of government: Burnham PM, Healey Chancellor; gilts sell off
blurb: Andy Burnham becomes PM and names John Healey Chancellor (replacing Starmer/Reeves); gilts sell off on 'fiscal flexibility' remarks. Plus a US Tax Court QTIP valuation ruling and firm commentary on the UK Elborne IHT case.

headline: Singapore weighs fund-manager tax cuts to counter Hong Kong
blurb: Quiet across most jurisdictions. Reports that MAS is reviewing Singapore's fund-manager tax concession to stay competitive with Hong Kong's proposed carried-interest package.
